caption: The drawing depicts a doll-like figure wearing a long, light-colored dress decorated with a subtle dotted pattern. The dress features a high collar and long sleeves that are gathered at the cuffs with ruffled trim. The front of the dress is adorned with large, circular buttons that are red with white centers, and red piping runs along the collar, the edge of the cuffs, and near the hem. The bottom of the dress has a ruffled trim that continues around the hem, with a train trailing behind. The figure has a pale face with rosy cheeks, red lips, and dark curly hair. To the right of the main figure, there is a secondary, less detailed drawing of the back of the dress in grayscale, showing the back view with the same ruffled hem and train. The background is plain, off-white, with no additional objects or details, and the illustration is signed "Stanley Mazar" near the bottom left.
title: Doll - "Mabel Ellis"
